schema.renderer: gpu: process has /dev/mali0 open and Panfork mapped. software: CPU drawing (cairo, shm, Skia). llvmpipe: GL on the CPU. unknown: no measurement.
schema.evidence: probe: tools/tablet/gpu-probe.sh on the date in tested. docs: result in docs/gta4xl.md, not measured again here. none: not measured.
schema.touch_rating: 1 to 5 for finger use. 5 is made for touch. This is an estimate from the toolkit and the start screen, not a hand test. null means no estimate.
schema.cpu_pct: Percent of one core, idle window, 5 s.

apps.name: Krita
apps.notes: Start screen only. Wayland start set in the desktop file. Canvas stroke and pen pressure not tested. Touch Docker is a hand step.

apps.name: Xournal++
apps.notes: GTK3 on Wayland, cairo. Good base for handwriting. Pen pressure in the app not tested.

apps.name: Rnote
apps.notes: Window seen on the screen. gpu-probe lost the process, because flatpak moves it to another cgroup. Renderer follows the Flatpak override: no /dev/dri, GSK_RENDERER=cairo.

apps.name: Inkscape
apps.notes: GTK3, cairo. Dense desktop UI.

apps.name: GIMP
apps.notes: GTK2, runs on Xwayland only. Dense desktop UI.

apps.name: MyPaint
apps.notes: GTK3, cairo.

apps.name: Drawing
apps.notes: Simple paint app, GTK3 on Wayland.

apps.name: Audacity
apps.notes: No microphone on this tablet, so no recording. Playback not tested.

apps.name: Shotcut
apps.notes: Start screen only. Export not tested.

apps.name: Kdenlive
apps.notes: The session ended at 15:17:00 while Kdenlive started: SIGKILL of user@1000. Cause not found, a link to Kdenlive is not proven. Removed, Shotcut covers the use.

apps.name: Blender
apps.notes: Panfork gives OpenGL 3.1 (eglinfo). Blender 4.0 needs OpenGL 4.3. On the CPU it is not usable.

apps.name: PhotoCraft
apps.notes: wgpu GL backend. One full core at idle in this probe, so it uses battery. Canvas not tested.

apps.name: VectorCraft
apps.notes: wgpu GL backend. High idle CPU.

apps.name: LightCraft
apps.notes: The window is on Mali, the photo pipeline logged: rendering on the CPU, no Vulkan adapter. First start failed, Xwayland was restarting then.

apps.name: PdfCraft
apps.notes: Log: wgpu adapter Mali-G72 (Panfrost), Gl. No Xwayland needed.

apps.name: ArtCraft
apps.notes: egui client. Generation runs in the cloud, it needs an ArtCraft account and credits or own provider keys. Only Create Image, Video and Audio exist in this client. Sign in not tested.

apps.name: NotebookLLM
apps.install: Flutter arm64 bundle to /opt/notebookllm, see docs/gta4xl.md

apps.notes: Sign in screen seen, login needs the user's account. Canvas tested with a demo entry in a build copy: touch works, Impeller on Mali, 101 MB, 20 % CPU. Pen size 3 draws broken thin lines. Pen pressure not tested.
